subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should OpenClaw expose Telegram pinned-message reads now, and should the first version be a gated on-demand action/command, part of broader Telegram read support, or deferred automatic context injection?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how durable Telegram chat content is authorized, surfaced to agents, and possibly injected into session context.

options.title: Gated on-demand action first
options.body: Add a Telegram-owned read-pinned or list-pins action/command backed by the Bot API, with an explicit action/config gate and no automatic session-start injection.

options.title: Fold into Telegram read work
options.body: Track pinned-message reads under the broader Telegram message-read design at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/12756 before adding a separate action.

options.title: Defer automatic context
options.body: Keep this out of runtime context until maintainers approve opt-in session-start injection, storage, and security semantics.

recommendation.title: Gated on-demand action first
recommendation.body: Add a Telegram-owned read-pinned or list-pins action/command backed by the Bot API, with an explicit action/config gate and no automatic session-start injection.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already tied to the prior product/security review and recent Telegram action/docs architecture history.
